title: Adapter SDK, Capability Manifest & Deterministic Reference VTT
objective: Implement a bounded provider-neutral adapter SDK, capability manifest and deterministic fake/reference VTT so the existing VTI projection, action, identity and permission contracts can be exercised end-to-end without depending on a commercial platform.
selection_boundaries: VTI-07 is completed_verified and its implementation/production authority is retired.
VTI-08 was selected from exact application main 692da4f4792426b9c62f6be14db60fc63eb09d6b.
VTI-08 may define a provider-neutral adapter interface, capability manifest and deterministic fake/reference VTT while preserving Multiversal as canonical authority.
Platform selection remains evidence-driven and deferred to VTI-09; VTI-08 may not commit the roadmap to a commercial vendor.

Provider credentials/accounts, commercial provider schemas, live external/canonical mutation, durable VTI persistence/new migration, provider activation, tester distribution, release/deployment, VTI-09+ and SGC-01+ remain unauthorized.

convergence_control.last_failure_signature: VTI-08 governed-start validation initially exposed stale historical registry projection and a predecessor regression that froze successor lifecycle; both were repaired before acceptance work.

changed_since_previous: VTI-08 governed-start control-plane projection was repaired and validated before merge.
Genuine matching VTI-08 application RED is sealed from exact head 420dced5ba3daf982d80a5b6cf141d2bdb4376bd with Linux/Windows identical deterministic receipt and successful comparator.

next_action: Implement only packages/contracts/src/virtual-tabletop-interoperability/adapter-sdk-capability-manifest-reference-vtt-contract.ts on application PR #437 / branch integration/vti-08-adapter-sdk-capability-manifest-reference-vtt. Then require exact-head repository health, Linux GREEN, Windows GREEN and deterministic comparison before merge.

authorized: provider-neutral adapter SDK interfaces that consume the completed VTI-02 through VTI-07 projection, identity, action/receipt and permission-preservation contracts without replacing them
deterministic capability manifests that declare supported, unsupported, conditional or unknown adapter fidelity and force safe downgrade when capability is absent
a deterministic fake/reference VTT that implements the provider-neutral adapter surface entirely as a local test double with no commercial provider dependency
end-to-end acceptance fixtures that exercise canonical projection, request/receipt replay, visibility/permission preservation and capability downgrade through the reference adapter
deterministic normalization, invariant validation and receipts needed to prove the bounded adapter/reference contract before production mutation is unlocked
not_authorized: commercial provider selection, ranking, provider-specific schemas or VTI-09 first-platform integration
provider credentials, external accounts, provider network access or live external synchronization mutation
new canonical rules, campaign, spatial, identity, permission or adjudication authority inside the adapter or reference VTT
durable VTI persistence or a new migration before separately authorized persistence work
provider activation, tester distribution, package distribution, release or deployment

governed_start_boundaries: VTI-07 remains completed_verified and frozen with implementation authority retired.
VTI-08 branch creation, bounded implementation scaffolding and acceptance-package authority are open only for the registered application branch.

Genuine matching self-hosted Linux/Windows VTI-08 acceptance RED has been sealed from exact head 420dced5ba3daf982d80a5b6cf141d2bdb4376bd, so bounded production mutation is authorized only for the registered provider-neutral VTI-08 contract.
The adapter SDK and reference VTT must consume completed VTI contracts; they may not create a parallel canonical rules, spatial, identity, permission or adjudication authority.
The reference VTT must remain deterministic and provider-neutral with no credentials, external accounts or commercial provider network dependency.
Platform selection remains evidence-driven and deferred to VTI-09; VTI-09+, SGC-01+, persistence/migration, provider activation, tester distribution and release/deployment remain unauthorized.
